label: AbsoluteErrorMagnitude
comment: The absolute difference between predicted and actual values has increased to an unacceptable amount, hence giving an absolute-error magnitude.

label: ForecastBias
comment: Signed forecast errors are persistently concentrated in one direction, with their mean shifted unacceptably away from zero.

label: LossOfAccuracy
comment: Signifies that data is incorrect when compared with reality.

label: LossOfAccurateProcessing
comment: Inputs to the process are processed such that the resulting outputs are inaccurate.

label: LossOfAdversarialAndWorstCaseRobustness
comment: A model is unacceptably vulnerable to deliberate or worst-case perturbations, hence giving a loss of adversarial and worst-case robustness.

label: LossOfClassBalancedCorrectness
comment: Recall has degraded for one or more classes, increasing the proportion of actual class members assigned an incorrect label, hence giving a loss of class-balanced performance.

label: LossOfClassConditionalDecisionPerformance
comment: Actual members of a class are not successfully detected and/or the assignment to a specified class is not reliable, hence giving a loss of class-conditional decision performance.

label: LossOfConsistency
comment: Comparable cases are not handled according to the same rules.

label: LossOfDetectionOrCoverageAccuracy
comment: Correct members of the target class are not correctly identified.

label: LossOfDiscreteLabelCorrectnessAndAgreement
comment: Predicted categorical labels are not consistent with corresponding ground-truth labels, hence giving a loss of discrete-label correctness and agreement.

label: LossOfDistributiveFairness
comment: There is a loss of fairness in the outcomes and the allocation of benefits and burdens across different groups.

label: LossOfEmpiricalAdversarialRobustness
comment: An unacceptable proportion of adversarial attacks successfully achieve their objectives, hence giving a loss of empirical adversarial robustness.

label: LossOfEquality
comment: Different groups of people receive different share or treatment rather than there being the sameness of allocation.

label: LossOfFairEqualityOfOpportunity
comment: Positions and opportunities are not open under genuinely fair conditions.

label: LossOfFairProcessing
comment: Inputs to the process are processed such that the resulting outputs are unduly detrimental, lack equality or equity, or have harmful bias or discrimination.

label: LossOfFairness
comment: Equality or equity is not represented within the data, with issues such as harmful bias or discrimination present.

label: LossOfFairnessInAccuracy
comment: Decisions are not based on correct information.

label: LossOfForecastSpecificTemporalAccuracy
comment: Forecasts are unacceptably inaccurate at the required future horizons, operational timepoints or event times, hence giving a loss of forecast-specific temporal accuracy.

label: LossOfHorizonOrTimepointSpecificAccuracy
comment: Forecasts evaluated at defined lead times are not aligned with corresponding observed outcomes, hence giving a loss of horizon or timepoint-specific accuracy.

label: LossOfNumericPointPredictionAccuracy
comment: The difference between predicted and actual numerical values is unacceptably large, hence giving a loss of numeric point-prediction accuracy.

label: LossOfOpportunityOrCapabilityFairness
comment: There is a loss of fairness in the real opportunities, freedoms and ability to achieve valued ways of living between different groups.

label: LossOfOutputSensitivityOrConfidenceStability
comment: Small and/or label-preserving input perturbations produce unacceptably large changes in performance or confidence, hence giving a loss of output sensitivity or confidence stability.

label: LossOfOverallLabelCorrectness
comment: Prediction labels disagree with ground-truth labels.

label: LossOfPerturbationPerformanceResilience
comment: Perturbed performance with specified input has an unacceptable performance compared to the corresponding clean-input performance, hence giving a loss of perturbation performance resilience.

label: LossOfPrecisionRecallComposite
comment: Precision, recall or both have declined, hence giving a loss of precision-recall composite.

label: LossOfPredictionConsistencyRate
comment: An unacceptable proportion of label-preserving input perturbations causes the predicted class to change, hence giving a loss of prediction consistency rate.

label: LossOfPredictionStabilityAndLocalSensitivity
comment: Small or label preserving input perturbations produce unacceptably large or frequent changes in the predictions, hence giving a loss of prediction stability and local sensitivity.

label: LossOfPredictiveValueAccuracy
comment: A significant proportion of predictions to a class are incorrect, hence giving a loss of predictive-value accuracy.

label: LossOfProceduralFairness
comment: There is a loss of fairness in the procedures and processes used to reach a decision.

label: LossOfRobustness
comment: The AI or ML system is unable to maintain a stable, reliable and acceptable performance when faced with input perturbations, noise, distribution shifts, unexpected conditions or deliberate adversarial attacks.

label: LossOfSinglePerturbationRelativePerformance
comment: An unacceptable proportion of clean-data performance is lost due to a specified perturbation being applied, hence giving a loss of single-perturbation relative performance.

label: LossOfWholeMatrixAssociationOrAgreement
comment: The overall correspondence between predicted and ground-truth assignments has weakened across the complete confusion matrix, hence giving a loss of whole-matric association or agreement.

label: SignedEventTimingError
comment: The predicted event time has moved unacceptably from the actual event time in either direction, giving an unacceptable temporal misalignment, hence giving a signed event-timing error.

label: SquaredErrorMagnitude
comment: The squared difference between predicted and actual values has increased to an unacceptable amount, hence giving a squared-error magnitude.

label: LossOfAttackSuccessRate
comment: Adversarial attempts achieve their objective and the model can be easily manipulated.

label: LossOfAverageAbsoluteOddsDifference
comment: There is not equality of odds between false positive and true positive rates between monitored groups and reference groups.

label: LossOfAverageOddsDifference
comment: There is inequality of odds of false positive and true positive rates between unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfBalancedAccuracy
comment: For equal weights applied to the classes, the performance and accuracy is not balanced across the classes.

label: LossOfBerthTiming
comment: There is a large difference between berthing prediction times and the actual berthing times.

label: LossOfConfidenceDecay
comment: Perturbed confidence is substantially lower than clean confidence, with the perturbed input change strongly affecting the output certainty.

label: LossOfConfidenceRetention
comment: Perturbed confidence is much lower than clean confidence.

label: LossOfDisparateImpact
comment: There is an unequal ratio of favourable outcome rates between unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfEqualOpportunityDifference
comment: True positive rates are unequal between unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfEqualizedOddsDifference
comment: There are not equalised odds of true positive and false positive rates between unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfErrorRateDifference
comment: The error rates for unprivileged and privileged groups are unequal.

label: LossOfErrorRateRatio
comment: Error rates for unprivileged and privileged groups are unequal.

label: LossOfF1Score
comment: Precision and/or recall is weak.

label: LossOfFalseDiscoveryRateDifference
comment: The false discovery rates between unprivileged and privileged groups is unequal.

label: LossOfFalseDiscoveryRateRatio
comment: False discovery rates (incorrect positives among predicted positives) between unprivileged and privileged groups are unequal.

label: LossOfFalseNegativeRateParity
comment: There are unequal false negative rates between unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfFalseOmissionRateDifference
comment: There are not equal odds between the false negative rate of a monitored group compared to the overall negative rate.

label: LossOfFalsePositiveRateParity
comment: There are unequal false positive rates between unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfFlipRate
comment: Perturbed inputs receive different predictions from their clean counterparts.

label: LossOfMatthewsCorrelationCoefficient
comment: There is a weak correlation between predicted and correct labels.

label: LossOfMeanAverageError
comment: Mean average error is large.

label: LossOfMeanSquaredError
comment: Mean squared error is large.

label: LossOfPrecision
comment: Predictions for a particular class are incorrect.

label: LossOfRecall
comment: Samples belonging to a particular class are incorrectly predicted.

label: LossOfRecallatBerthTimePoint
comment: Berth events are missed when they should have been anticipated.

label: LossOfRobustnessRatio
comment: Perturbed performance is much lower than clean performance.

label: LossOfStatisticalParityDifference
comment: There is a difference in rates of favourable outcomes received by unprivileged and privileged groups.

label: LossOfTheilIndex
comment: There is inequality in the benefit allocation for individuals.

label: LocalLossOfUserTW
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents gained access to a host, with user rights (possibly associated with a specific process), when the host is in a specific location and/or connected to a specific subnet.

label: LossOfExploitTW
comment: Exposure of software vulnerabilities to exploitation by attackers in some context.

label: LossOfAuthenticity
comment: Forging or alteration of data (which may be embedded in an IoT device) in a way designed to induce false behaviour in other assets consuming the data.

label: LossOfConfidentiality
comment: Disclosure of data (which may be embedded in an IoT device) to unauthorised parties, or a state where prevention or detection of such a disclosure cannot be ensured.

label: LossOfIntegrity
comment: Alteration or corruption of data (which may be embedded in an IoT device) such that its use will produce incorrect outputs or outcomes, but which may or may not be malicious and designed to subvert assets consuming the data.

label: LossOfTimeliness
comment: Represents a state in which a data asset is somewhat out of date, or a process or human has outdated or (temporarily) unavailable inputs.

label: MalwareInfection
comment: Insertion into the asset of malicious, self-propagating software.

label: NotDecrypted
comment: An adverse behaviour of stored or flowing copies of data, signifying that the copy is not available in an unencrypted form. Considered an adverse effect because it can lead to loss of availability for the data if a legitimate user or process lacks a suitable decryption key, and used to model side effects of encryption controls.

label: NotEncrypted
comment: An adverse behaviour of stored or flowing copies of data, signifying that the copy is not available in an encrypted form. Considered as an adverse effect as it means confidentiality could be breached without compromising a decryption key, and used to model side effects of encryption controls.

label: PhysicalShutdown
comment: Signifies that the physical process controlled by the Controller has been halted by physical means.

label: InService
comment: Engagement by an asset in the system, which is usually desirable, but means the asset is open to attack, abuse or misuse (and hence it is modelled as a potential threat consequence).

label: LocalLossOfControl
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents gained admin privileges on a host, when the host is in a specific location and/or connected to a specific subnet.

label: LossOfCapacity
comment: Reduction in the capacity of a Data Centre to handle demands placed on it by automatically provisioned for hosts and processes.

label: Loss Of Control
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents gained admin rights in some system context.

label: LossOfDefaultTW
comment: Modelling artefact, corresponding to the trustworthiness attribute DefaultTW, which is already set by default to the lowest trustworthiness level.

label: LossOfExtrinsicTW
comment: Deterioration in the quality and/or integrity of software engineering used to implement the asset, such that it will contain more software vulnerabilities likely to be discovered by an attacker.

label: LossOfIntrinsicTW
comment: Deterioration in the quality and/or integrity of software engineering used to implement the asset, such that it will contain more functional software bugs that cause errors or crashes without external provocation.

label: LossOfNetworkControl
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents can control routing within the abstract or logical subnet.

label: LossOfNetworkUserTW
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents have access to the abstract or logical network subnet, i.e. they can access a connected host that may or may not be part of the modelled system.

label: LossOfResourceTW
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents can control the provisining of or allocation of resources to the asset.

label: Loss Of User TW
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents gained user rights in some system context.

label: NetworkAccess
comment: A malicious agent is able to request a connection to the logical subnet, i.e., they can send messages to the controlling router or process but they do not have an address on the subnet (so they cannot yet exchange messages with other connected hosts).

label: Overloaded
comment: The asset is being used or requested more than allowed or expected.

label: TotalLoad
comment: The total load on a Data Centre.

label: BackdoorInsertion
comment: Insertion of a back door into a host operating system or other software stored and running on a host.

label: VulnerabilityDiscovered
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of one or more vulnerabilities in software associated with the affected host or process.

label: BandwidthUnmanaged
comment: Signifies that bandwidth used by message flows through an interface cannot be restricted based on their source and/or destination addresses.

label: CommsSnoopable
comment: Applies to a network or communication channel, signifying that messages in that network or channel can be intercepted and read via passive snooping or via a man-in-the-middle attack.

label: ConnectionsAllowed
comment: Applies to a network communication route, i.e. the Interface between a Host and a Subnet, or a Logical Segment representing a route between two Subnets, signifying that by default, messages will be allowed to flow.

label: NetworkSpoofing
comment: The connection from a device to a subnet is really with a spoofed subnet. This means a malicious party is routing between the device and the subnet with which it is supposed to be connected.

label: AbsenceOfDiagnosis
comment: The diagnosis process does not occur or does not identify a disease or condition, leading to patient harm through no disease or condition being identified.

label: AbsenceOfTreatment
comment: The actions to treat or alleviate a disease or condition are not taken, leading to patient harm.

label: DelayedDiagnosis
comment: The diagnosis process is delayed, leading to the disease or condition being identified but not in a timely fashion, causing patient harm.

label: DelayedTreatment
comment: The correct actions to treat or alleviate a disease or condition are taken, but not in a timely fashion, leading to patient harm.

label: InappropriateTreatment
comment: The wrong actions to treat or alleviate a disease or condition are taken, leading to patient harm.

label: Misdiagnosis
comment: The diagnosis process occurs but the wrong disease or condition is identified, leading to patient harm.

label: PhysicalBreach
comment: The physical boundary and means of access control to a private space has been compromised.

label: PhysicalIntrusion
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents have or could have physical access to the space.

label: LossOfConnectivity
comment: There is a loss of connectivity between processes.

label: ServiceChannelsAllowed
comment: Applies to a communication route, i.e. the Interface between a Host and a Subnet, or a Logical Segment representing a route between two Subnets. Signifies that exceptions do exist allowing client-service connections and communications to tunnel through a default deny routing policy.

label: ClientImpersonation
comment: The authentication credentials of a client accessing a service are no longer secure and reliable, i.e. the client could can be impersonated to the service. This does not necessarily mean an attacker can access the service, only that they have access to client credentials.

label: DeputyConfusion
comment: The client is influenced by a malicious actor who is able to induce the client to send malicious requests to its service.

label: LossOfAccessibility
comment: Referring to a client-service relationship, representing inability of the client to authenticate with the service.

label: LossOfAnonUserTW
comment: Untrustworthy users are able to send messages to a service from the direction of a specific client. This relates to any message so it includes messages sent anonymously, prior to authentication. It is not related to which users can access the service. Consequently, a high likelihood is not in itself a cause for concern, so the impact level should never be raised for this behaviour.

label: LossOfClientTW
comment: A malicious actor is able to access the related service and authenticate as the related client. This means the attacker is able to send requests to the service, and either the attacker has access to client credentials or the service fails to authenticate before allowing access.

label: LossOfProxyUserTW
comment: A malicious actor is able to send messages via a reverse proxy to a related service. The service is exposed to malicious requests, but not directly from an attacker.

label: LossOfServiceTW
comment: The service accessed by a client is controlled by a malicious actor, usually (but not always) caused by the service being hacked by an external attacker.

label: ServiceImpersonation
comment: The service accessed by a client is an imposter.

label: Theft
comment: Signifies that a (mobile) device has been stolen and an attacker now has possession and the ability to misuse the device.

label: TheftOfControl
comment: Untrusted, potentially malicious agents gained control of a device or process running on it after the device has been removed by theft from the system.

label: LossOfAstuteness
comment: Being undermined in a way that causes a lapse in judgement regarding security risks in a Human, leaving them more open to being deceived into taking inappropriate actions.

label: LossOfAvailability
comment: The asset cannot (or will not) carry out its function within the system, failing to interact with other assets as expected.

label: LossOfBenevolence
comment: Effect of external influences on a Human that introduce or foster motives or desires to cause adverse effects.

label: LossOfCompetence
comment: Erosion of competence in a Human, caused by changes in themselves, their role or the technology they use to carry out that role within the system.

label: LossOfReliability
comment: The human, device or software process asset is liable to make errors with unacceptable frequency or extent. Caused by internal failings such as lack of expertise, software bugs, etc., or by using forged, corrupt or inaccurate information as input, or some other dependency on some other asset that is not reliable.

label: LossOfTrust
comment: The Stakeholder (usually a Human) is no longer willing to fulfil their role in the system. NOT YET USED IN ANY THREAT.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-A-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would compromise asset availability.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-AU-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability that can be accessed without authentication.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-C-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would compromise data confidentiality.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-I-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would allow data to be altered.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-M-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would allow an attacker to take control.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-QI-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would allow an attacker to inject queries that will be passed to a trusting back-end process.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-U-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would allow an attacker user level access.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-VA-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability that can be accessed only from the local network, requiring access to either the broadcast or collision domain of the vulnerable software.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-VL-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability that can be accessed from a local shell or via physical access.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-VN-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability that can be accessed from a remote network.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-W-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability whose exploitation would allow insertion of self-propagating malware.

label: LossOfExtrinsic-XS-TW
comment: Discovery by potential attackers of a vulnerability in a service whose exploitation would allow injection of malicious scripts into a client process.
